row.name: Alamar Biosciences Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=36 breakdowns=6 bursts_in_base=4 giveback=0.57 tightness=0.94 base_volume_vs_leg=1.32 base_volume_vs_avg=1.09
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 36 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 6 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 0.57 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 8.9% vs its 20-SMA, 12.4% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The consolidation box spans 36 sessions with 6 measured 4%-plus breakdowns and 4 bursts inside it — the chart confirms a wide, choppy, overlapping base that is visibly declining from the August spike high toward the 30 area before recovering, which is exactly the loose structure Bonde rejects. On top of that, the burst bar's range is only 60% of the widest bar in the prior five sessions (RE FAIL) and volume came in below both the prior session and the 50-session average with a rank of 22 out of 60 (VOL FAIL), so the expansion signal itself is weak. Three independent recorded failures (C, RE, VOL) plus a visually chaotic base make this untradeable under the method.
claude.key_risk: The base is a multi-month choppy range with repeated large swings; any continuation attempt faces the same overhead supply that has capped price near 37–38 since early August.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst-day close of 34.36 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace.
